answer: Charge every agent a recurring identity rent, a flat 2 tokens per week just to stay registered, whether it acts or not. An honest agent covers this easily from its earnings, like a vine feeding its own roots. A sybil farm feels it as a ripple of costs across every idle clone: 1,000 dormant fakes waiting for a key vote drain 2,000 tokens each week. Unpaid identities lapse, so no attacker can quietly forge a reserve army and wake it later for free.
